2004 Clairidge Avenue
Killeen, TX 76549
$199,900, 4 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,562 SF, MLS# 609759

Welcome home to this perfectly situated 4-bedroom, 2-bath retreat, designed for easy family living! Built in 1994 and offering 1,562 sq. ft. of comfortable space, this home places you minutes from, grocery stores and local dining. The functional layout features a cozy living area, a large kitchen, 2 car garage, formal dining, breakfast nook, private back yard and four spacious bedrooms, offering room for everyone to work or play. Picture cozy movie nights in the spacious living room, or hosting summer barbecues in the fully fenced backyard. Your new, convenient lifestyle awaits in the heart of Stratford Third addition, only 5 minutes from your morning coffee, the grocery store, your workplace; close to schools and the base, this is the smart move. Book your showing now!

2 full bath
